entities.summary: The Islamic Azad University, Damavand Branch is a campus of Islamic Azad University system in Iran. It was established in 2002 with two major fields. This branch now has 54 fields – majors and more than 12,000 students in bachelor, master and Ph.D. levels, located in the east of Tehran, is a branch of technical and engineering departments in the country. Islamic Azad University of rafsanjan is a university in Asia, established in 2002. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
